title: Lemony Kale and Parmesan Salad
summary: Sharp, crunchy, cold salad of kale or romaine, lemon, shaved Parmesan, and toasted seeds. Cuts through steak and sweet potatoes.

ingredients.item: bunches lacinato kale or heads of romaine
ingredients.prep: kale stemmed and thinly sliced; romaine chopped

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Shake or whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, garlic, and salt.

steps.title: Dress the greens
steps.text: Kale: massage with a third of the dressing for a minute to soften it, ahead of time is fine. Romaine: dress right before serving so it stays crisp.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Toss with the rest of the dressing and top with Parmesan and toasted seeds.

notes: Something cold and acidic on the plate does more next to rich steak than another hot vegetable.
